annotation.title_clean: Bozza di linee guida per l'adozione di IA nella pubblica amministrazione
annotation.title_en: Draft Guidelines for the Adoption of AI in Public Administration
named_instruments_referenced: Piano triennale per l'informatica nella PA 2024-2026
annotation.summary_en: AgID's draft guidelines (v1.0, 14 Feb 2025, put out for public consultation) on how Italian public administrations should adopt AI under the 2024-2026 Three-Year IT Plan. They set out an adoption model, risk classification aligned with the EU AI Act, impact assessment, ethical governance, transparency, training, data quality, data protection and cybersecurity, with annexes containing tools.
key_provisions_or_claims: Public administrations must follow an AI adoption model covering strategy, use cases, governance, risk management and impact assessment
AI systems are classified by risk in line with the EU AI Act
The draft provides a model code of ethics and requires transparency and disclosure obligations
It sets data governance and quality requirements, drawing on AI Act Art. 10 and ISO/IEC 8183
It addresses AI cybersecurity threats (evasion, poisoning, privacy and abuse attacks) and defines KPIs and SLAs for AI suppliers
